messages:
marie (PM): Quick thread to lock down a small, testable gating matrix for cross-region cutover + tenant isolation. Goal: customer pilot with Acme-lite. Thoughts?

lee (Eng): short answer: yes. prefer staged canary + emergency fallback. share proposed gates.

marie (PM): proposed flow: sandbox smoke -> single-tenant staging canary -> 5% prod for 12h -> 25% 12h -> 100% if all green. Gates: latency, errors, cache warmup, quality delta.

sam (Arch): add a p95 cold-start gate for model variants when kv-miss > X. we hit a regression in last rollout.

tess (SRE): require fallback policy in place: automatic route to region-local compatible variant + circuit breaker after 30s of elevated errors. also need alert "tenant.failover" and a runbook.

nina (Sales): Acme wants 30s cross-region failover and contractual tail-latency. can we safely promise any number?

lee (Eng): 30s to start routing yes, full perf restoration depends on cache and may take minutes. recommend contract language: "automated failover within 60s; expected performance restoration within 10 minutes under normal conditions."

marie (PM): draft launch thresholds: p99 <= 150ms regional, errors < 0.5%, failover init < 60s, KV warmup for pinned tenants < 3m, no regressions on top-10 prompts. open to tuning.

sam (Arch): add policy: SLA-triggered isolation. if tenant p99 > 250ms for 5m, auto-move to isolated slice and notify CS. Define migration back window.

tess (SRE): operational pre-reqs: alerts, smoke harness hitting top-20 prompts every 10m, chaos test plan (simulate region outage) in staging. If smoke fails -> rollback.

nina (Sales): Acme agrees to pilot if we scope to 2 tenants and limited model sizes. they'll sign NDA this week.

lee (Eng): we can accelerate pilot if cross-region routing disabled for pilot and we use quantized variants. less infra changes.

marie (PM): action items: @lee open routing-policy PR with canary hooks; @tess add runbook + chaos plan; @sam write acceptance checklist; @nina confirm contract wording with Acme. I'll publish gating matrix doc and tag owners.

deploy-bot: Created ticket #CUTO-2025 to track geo-pilot-gates. Owners: lee, tess, sam, marie. ETA: 2025-08-01.

nina (Sales): noted. I'll push for a 6-week pilot window. :thumbsup:

marie (PM): thanks all, will post first draft by EOD for quick review."
